fiabilite: 7th out of 23 small SUVs (What Car 2024); Volkswagen reliability 18/31 brands, Skoda 13/31
pannes: 1.0/1.2 TSI turbocharged petrol engine; 7-speed DSG transmission proven; complex infotainment system causing occasional frustration

fiabilite: among the top performers in its category with no clearly documented major flaws, but the 1.6 TDI 115 version and the DSG7 gearbox concentrate the most negative feedback
pannes: 1.6 TDI 115: chronic water pump issues, cited as the riskiest engine in the range; 1.5 TSI 150 (early versions): jerks at low speed, engine cut-outs on start-up, oil consumption reaching 1L/5,000 km according to some reports; gearbox

fiabilite: 74/100 (2024), 69/100 (2025) according to Auto Reliability Index; continuous improvements 2023–2025
pannes: 1.5L TSI turbo petrol engine robust; improved 8-speed automatic gearbox; 2022 had low score of 59/100 (engine issues); DSG transmission reliable

fiabilite: varies by engine; versions post-2019 (2nd generation) rated significantly more reliable
pannes: TSI timing chain: tensioner issue potentially leading to engine destruction from 80,000 km on some 2017–2019 models according to certain sources; 2.0 TDI: dual-mass flywheel, EGR valve, DPF, water pump, injectors and turbo cited as fragile, power loss and warning lights

fiabilite: overall reliability rated satisfactory for the 1.9 TDI 105 hp with many examples exceeding 200,000 km according to one source, subject to regular maintenance
pannes: dual-mass flywheel identified as the most recurrent weak point (34 failures reported out of 151 reviews according to one source), followed by the clutch (32 cases) and the cooling system; water pump frequently cited as a source of breakdown; fragile EGR valve, sensitive to clogging

fiabilite: correct reliability with rigorous maintenance despite known flaws
pannes: DSG gearbox with jerks in urban driving, especially on 2008–2015 models; 1.9/2.0 TDI diesel engines (pre-2005 especially) with turbo, injector, dual-mass flywheel failures; engine management ECUs sometimes requiring reprogramming; TSI petrol engines with carbon build-up

fiabilite: 0.5 breakdowns/year reported over 60,000 km according to one source, average cumulative maintenance cost estimated at €1,650 between 60,000 and 150,000 km; overall mechanics rated solid, the 1.0 MPI being renowned for its robustness and low maintenance
pannes: cooling system regularly problematic: thermostat tending to stick in the closed position (risk of engine overheating), hoses ageing prematurely, water pump developing leaks at the gasket and noisy bearings from 80,000 km

fiabilite: correct reliability subject to rigorous maintenance
pannes: requires frequent oil changes (max 15,000 km, or even 10,000 km in urban use, oil to VW 504 00/507 00 standards); timing chain monitoring recommended every 60,000 km on pre-2013 models (suspicious noises on cold start)

fiabilite: to_check — specific data for the 2018+ generation poorly documented by consulted French-language sources, most feedback on fiches-auto.fr/largus.fr relating to the previous 2010–2017 generation
pannes: 48V mild-hybrid system (B4/B5): 48V battery losing capacity after 50,000–80,000 km, more frequent error messages reported as a result; integrated starter-generator (ISG) potentially showing bearing wear and failing between 80,000 and 120,000 km according to some sources

fiabilite: 7/10 — sophisticated electronics source of breakdowns
pannes: diesel engines injection/turbo issues after 150,000 km, air suspension compressor failure at 80,000 km, multimedia electronics freezing/restarting

fiabilite: reliability rated adequate for the D4 diesel, which remains the most common on the used market according to one source, with many examples exceeding 200,000 km without major breakdowns
pannes: 2.0 diesel engines (D3/D4/D5): injection issues from 100,000–150,000 km, clogged injectors and faulty high-pressure pump linked to poor fuel quality, causing irregular running and overconsumption; faulty EGR valve cited as a 'classic' issue

fiabilite: mechanical reliability correct but fragile electronics
pannes: frequent electronic breakdowns (key, multimedia/infotainment system — complete failures, frozen screens; driver assistance systems); diesel dilution in oil on diesel versions in short urban trips (DPF not regenerating correctly); seat squeaks and panoramic roof creaks

fiabilite: sophisticated electronics generating occasional frustrating breakdowns, mechanics rated solid according to owner feedback
pannes: AdBlue level sensor regularly displaying phantom errors (false alerts)

fiabilite: to_check — 2016 models to avoid as a priority according to one source, particular vigilance recommended on the D5 2016–2018 and T8 hybrids 2020–2022
pannes: D5 diesel: the two turbochargers (bi-turbo) operating at high pressure can suffer power loss or even destruction in case of degraded lubrication, intake leak or inconsistent electronic management; AdBlue system may immobilise the vehicle if the tank is empty or the system fails

fiabilite: very good charging performance, overall positive behaviour in Europe
pannes: driver assistance systems (autonomous pilot) may be unstable (unexpected braking, lane-keeping disconnections); LFP battery 2025 safer than NMC; software system to monitor

fiabilite: excellent charging speeds 10–80% in 12–13 minutes demonstrated
pannes: no major issues documented in real-world use in Europe; battery and cooling system to monitor over time

fiabilite: engine generally solid and relatively reliable according to several sources, CP2 engine reputed without known design flaws leading to premature failure
pannes: reports of serious CP2 engine failures extremely rare, 100,000 km achievable according to one source provided maintenance intervals are strictly respected; suspension rated somewhat soft as standard, often budgeted for improvement by owners

fiabilite: considered the benchmark in the maxi-scooter segment according to one source, owner feedback generally very positive in the long term with annual maintenance followed
pannes: fuel pump: regularly reported difficulties, source of power loss or difficult starting; electrical issues: ignition problems related to fuses or battery frequently reported; transmission (belt, rollers, variator) identified as the weakest point
